composition.currentLayout: One three-stage form serves new events, repeated templates, restored drafts, and imported events: Event basics; When & where; then Guests/Booking & live guide. Optional details are disclosed on demand. Review is explicit before creation. HostCreateEventRouteState resolves route club loading/error/not-found/ready branches before HostCreateEventRouteScreen renders CreateEventScreen. CreateEventWizardStep owns canonical step order, titles, form-key spec construction, and schedule-validation metadata. CreateEventWizardValidationPlan owns current form-key selection and schedule validation policy. CreateEventWizardState owns step header/footer/mutation/success display state plus typed back/primary/save-draft intents. CreateEventSuccessNavigationEffect owns success destination, manage-event route parameters, and route extra payload. CreateEventDraftSnapshot owns draft dirty-tracking signature and EventDraft serialization. CreateEventDraftActionState owns new-vs-existing draft dirty decisions, draft id selection, and save/update success copy. CreateEventDraftRestoreState owns EventDraft-to-form restore mapping, stale enum fallback, restored schedule text, location restore state, policy restore state, and restored Event Success defaults. CreateEventDraftSideEffectState owns draft-check, picker visibility, picker delete intent, and post-submit delete intent policy. CreateEventScreen keeps form-controller assignment, PageController movement, platform picker execution, controller mutation triggers, and Navigator/context side effects inline.

composition.currentLayout: The Audience destination has People, Audiences, Forms, and Responses peer tabs under one organizer scope. People presents CRM summary, search, grouped filters, Sort/Filters controls, export, manual add, duplicate review and a paginated divided directory; nested routes own full-page add and customer detail. stateController.notes: HostInboxScreen is the Host-owned Inbox destination and follows the shell-selected organizer. Inbox selects that organizer's live or nearest-upcoming event, keeps General explicit, scopes personal inquiry threads by organizer and event, classifies Booked and Prospective rows, and derives broadcast counts from eventParticipations rather than conversation count. The user-facing Sends workspace owns mixed Campaign/Announcement/Follower update history, groups every registered route under In Catch or WhatsApp, owns the route-specific follower composer and durable personal-WhatsApp handoff queue, and owns the complete campaign lifecycle; its compatibility wire value remains campaigns. Manual handoffs distinguish queued, device-opened and explicit host-asserted states, revalidate a stored endpoint immediately before every queue launch, and never claim provider delivery or read evidence. WhatsApp sender setup lives on the dedicated organizer messaging route. Event broadcasts and follower updates create durable Activity plus preference-gated push and never create chat fan-out. Person rows combine only server-verified organizer-scoped identity. Every reply chooses one authorized route; paging, read receipts and drafts retain source identity and account generation. New message selects a person before resolving available routes.

composition.currentLayout: HostInboxScreen presents the local product title Messaging beneath the shell destination Inbox and follows the shell-selected organizer. Its header names the selected responsibility: Inbox owns one-to-one conversations and replies, while Sends owns outbound intent, manual handoff work, delivery history, and route-specific reports. Inbox watches the organizer's events, personal inquiry previews, selected Event or General scope, and search. CatchAdaptiveMasterDetailLayout measures the route body after shell chrome, keeps compact navigation pushed, and presents a 360 px index beside a keyed selected thread at 720 px or wider; the route retains per-thread drafts across resize. Sends consumes Audience-owned saved audiences or Events-owned audience references without redefining either authority and keeps its operational content in an 840 px lane. HostInboxViewModel keeps organizer, Event/General, Booked/Prospective, and thread-count boundaries explicit.
composition.targetLayout: Keep Inbox as the Host-owned communication destination, with the local Messaging title and first-class Inbox and Sends workspaces. Preserve organizer and event provenance, reuse shared header and row primitives, and keep event announcements as Activity plus push rather than chat fan-out. The campaigns query value remains a compatibility wire detail, never the visible workspace label.
